try { throw new Error("bad"); } catch ({ message }) { console.log(message); }
try { throw [1]; } catch ([code]) { console.log(code); }
try { throw 1; } catch ({ message }: any) { console.log(message); }
try { throw 1; } catch ({}) {}
try { throw 1; } catch ([]) {}
try { throw 1; } catch ({ ...r }) {}
try { throw 1; } catch ({ a }: unknown) {}
try { throw 1; } catch ({ a = 1 }) {}
